# RC-034 excluded verification inputs

`play-topologies.json` contains geometric witnesses generated by
`tools/rc034_build_play_topologies.py`: simple paths and one Split/Join diamond
on the ordinary 4×4 board. The verification player reads the naturally sampled
endpoints, available kit, hand, energy and ranks, then issues normal controller
commands. Every planned cost/damage/shield must match the real evaluator. No
layout, card, health, energy, stock or random state is installed into gameplay.

`presentation-victories.json` retains successful commands from real ordinary
starter encounters for rendered replay. Production data, the eight-card
starter and 30 HP are unchanged. These are selected reproducible witnesses,
not a win-rate or optimal-play claim.

All of `tests/` and QA outputs are excluded from resource packages. The earlier
RC-032 calibration and RC-033 observation fixtures keep their separate scope.
